title: Skip intro
note: It's Always Sunny S1 E1 at 1:47. The intro runs 1:44 to 2:11 (TheIntroDB). The chip stays 10 s; OK skips to 2:11. The hint bar shows the first 5 times.

title: Skip intro in the button row
note: The controls are up during the intro (▲ pressed at 1:52). The floating chip moves into the row, after Next episode so nothing else moves, and ▲ lands on it. When the intro ends the pill goes and focus returns to the seek thumb.

title: After a skip: the way back
note: After every skip, pressed or automatic. S1 E2's 28 s intro was skipped; for 5 s OK goes back to its start (OK does nothing for the first 1.5 s). The two-line subtitle would touch the chip, so it rises to 8 above it.

title: Skip recap
note: Lost S2 E1 at 0:06. The recap runs 0:02 to 0:28. Recaps have speech; this short line does not touch the chip, so it stays where it is. After 5 views the hint bar stops; the key cap on the chip says what OK does.

title: Up next when the credits start
note: Checked credits: the match is Sure and the downloaded subtitles end before 21:28 (TheIntroDB). Up next comes at 21:28 and counts 15 s. Unchanged: OK plays now, Back stays on this one.

title: Options > Skip intros and recaps
note: OK on the Options row. The same setting as Account > Playback. The foot says what is known for this episode.

title: Up next on unchecked credits
note: S1 E1 at 21:30 with the file's own subtitles (they can't be read ahead), so the credits time is unchecked. The card shows at 21:28 without a count; from the last 40 s it counts to the end as today.

title: Options in an episode
note: ▼ in an episode. Skip intros and recaps is the last row (episodes only), with the setting as its value.
